    oracle_instance('0', '1', '_',
                    lhs=integrate(cos(0*x)*cos(1*x), x, 0, pi),
                    rhs=0, relation='==', edge=True),
    oracle_instance('2', '5', '_',
                    lhs=integrate(cos(2*x)*cos(5*x), x, 0, pi),
                    rhs=0, relation='==', edge=False),
    oracle_instance('4', '1', '_',
                    lhs=integrate(cos(4*x)*cos(1*x), x, 0, pi),
                    rhs=0, relation='==', edge=False),
]
